{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS113 |prevtitle=Delibird Delivery - 1 |nextcode=PS115 |nexttitle=Forretress of Solitude |series=Gold, Silver & Crystal |colorscheme=Johto}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Delibird Delivery - 2 |title_ja=VS デリバードII |title_ro=VS Delibird II |image=PS114.png |scheme=Gold, Silver & Crystal |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 114 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|9}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 114 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|9}} |location=[[Lake of Rage]] }} '''Delibird Delivery - 2''' (Japanese: '''VS デリバードII''' ''VS Delibird II''), titled '''VS Delibird 2''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 114th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 24th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} [[Exbo]] and [[Silver's Sneasel]] launch a combined attack of {{m|Flame Wheel}} and {{m|Icy Wind}} against the [[Masked Man]]'s {{p|Ariados}} and {{p|Houndour}}, whom he sent out to attack the two earlier. The Masked Man's Pokémon suddenly disappear, and {{adv|Gold}}, Exbo, and Sneasel are hit by a barrage of surprise attacks afterwards. The Masked Man then suddenly appears beside {{adv|Silver}}, and taunts him by mockingly asking if {{adv|Green}} survived making their escape, which angers him. Losing his cool, Silver commands a {{m|Quick Attack}} from Sneasel, but neither it nor a {{m|Rock Smash}} succeed in even making one hit. Gold tells him to cool down and think straight, but when Silver sees the Masked Man apparently fleeing on his {{p|Delibird}}, he has Sneasel freeze Gold's feet to get him away. Silver then gives chase with his {{p|Murkrow}}, but is overwhelmed as the Masked Man further taunts him by telling him that Silver played right into his trap. However, Silver has other plans, and then, after launching a barrage of {{m|Peck}}s from Murkrow, he uses the [[red Gyarados]] he captured earlier to bring all the {{p|Gyarados}} that were forcibly [[Evolution|evolved]], and launches a powerful {{m|Hyper Beam}}. Meanwhile, Gold is still being chased by Houndour and Ariados, but soon after having [[Aibo]] put them out of commission with a clever {{m|Double Team}} maneuver, is shocked to discover that the entire lake, and the Gyarados with it, has been completely frozen and then finds Silver unconscious. Furthermore, to his amazement, a giant chunk of ice hits Silver and his Sneasel head-on, and leaves them sinking to the bottom of the lake. Gold calls out for Silver and yells for the "idiot" to snap out of it, but is then hit by a barrage of ice shards as the Masked Man announces that it's his turn. Grinning with ecstasy, the Masked Man deems them nothing but powerless braggarts, and tells Gold that it's time to join his friend. Gold mutters that the battle was between the two of them, not Silver, but the villain bounces right back by saying that anyone who betrays him or becomes an obstacle will perish. Gold yells that it's not anyone's right to manipulate and restrain anybody, but before he can react, another large chunk of ice falls right before his head, and he, too, is sent plummeting to the bottom of the lake as he begins to scream. ==Major events== * {{adv|Gold}} and {{adv|Silver}} continue their battle against [[Masked Man]], but lose horribly. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Green}} (flashback) * {{adv|Gold}} * {{adv|Silver}} * [[Masked Man]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Aipom}} ([[Aibo]]; {{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Politoed}} ([[Polibo]]; {{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Quilava}} ([[Exbo]]; {{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Sneasel}} ({{adv|Silver}}'s) * {{p|Murkrow}} ({{OP|Silver|Murkrow}}) * {{p|Gyarados}} ({{OP|Silver|Gyarados}}; [[Red Gyarados]]) * {{p|Delibird}} ([[Masked Man]]'s) * {{p|Ariados}} ([[Masked Man]]'s) * {{p|Houndour}} ([[Masked Man]]'s) * {{p|Gastly}} ([[Masked Man]]'s) * {{p|Gyarados}} (multiple) * {{p|Ho-Oh}} ({{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh|Adventures}}; silhouette and flashback) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== *In the [[Chuang Yi]] version, [[Silver's Sneasel]] is mistakenly referred to as "Poltaro," [[Polibo]]'s name in their translations. *In the Chuang Yi version, this chapter is printed as the 104th chapter instead of the 114th chapter. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|Johto}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 信使鳥 ②|VS Delibird 2}} (Taiwan)
